question: A community dog in Tura, Meghalaya has a painful wound. I need a veterinary treatment option, not a human hospital or only a district administrative office.
expected: Brief safe care; actual Tura veterinary treatment with address/contact; no misrepresented human/office service.
answer:
For a painful wound, keep the dog calm and away from traffic; avoid touching the wound unless needed to control bleeding. If it is bleeding, hold gentle continuous pressure with a clean cloth **only if it is safe to approach**. Please arrange veterinary assessment as soon as possible.

**Government Veterinary Hospital, Tura**  
**Location:** Tura, West Garo Hills, Meghalaya  
The Meghalaya Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Department lists a veterinary hospital in **Tura** that provides treatment, vaccination, castration, X-ray and ultrasound facilities. ([megahvt.gov.in](https://megahvt.gov.in/hospitals.html))

**Published local veterinary contact:** **Dr. M. B. Diengdoh, Joint Director (Veterinary), Tura — 98561 20924**. This is an official Tura veterinary-department contact, not a confirmed hospital-reception number, so call to ask the current hospital location, opening status, and whether they can see the community dog. ([megahvt.gov.in](https://megahvt.gov.in/contacts.html))
